ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a mosquito life cycle around water. Label B is on a group of eggs at the water surface. Label D is on a worm-like larva in the water. Label A is on a pupa in the water. Label C is on a mosquito above the water with visible wings. Reasoning: The stage with wings is the winged mosquito form shown at label C. In a mosquito life cycle, the winged form is the adult stage; eggs, larvae, and pupae do not have functional wings. Therefore, the stage that has wings is the adult.
